# Ashish Pathak

> Knowledge Architect with 12+ years in enterprise information architecture, AI strategy,
> knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.

This site (rag-arena.fly.dev) is both a portfolio and a working RAG reference implementation.
It runs three retrieval strategies (lexical/BM25, dense vector, knowledge-graph traversal) over
one identical chunk set, scores every answer with deterministic evaluation metrics (no LLM
grading its own output), and exposes a live API a visitor can query directly.

## Who this is

Ashish Kumar Pathak. Based in Hyderabad, India. Currently a Staff Technical Writer building an
AI-driven knowledge platform at ServiceNow. Prior roles at Autodesk, Capgemini, Infosys, and
others, spanning technical documentation, content strategy, and knowledge architecture.

## What this project demonstrates

- Multi-strategy retrieval (lexical, vector, graph, hybrid) compared on identical inputs
- Deterministic RAG evaluation: groundedness, context relevance, citation coverage, entity leakage
- PII redaction before any content is indexed or sent to an LLM
- A self-correcting multi-agent pipeline (LangGraph) that re-routes retrieval on a failed grade
- A RAG-readiness analyzer that scores arbitrary text 0-100 for how well it will retrieve

- / — portfolio home, about, work samples, and the interactive playground
